description: This script gathers discussion data from GitHub, analyzes commenters over various timeframes, updates a YAML file with the results, and automates creating a pull request with the updates.

classes.name: RateLimiter
classes.description: Handles rate limiting for GitHub API requests, managing wait times based on remaining points and reset times.

classes.name: Author
classes.description: Represents a GitHub user with login, avatar URL, and profile URL.

classes.name: CommentsNode
classes.description: Represents a comment in a discussion, including creation time and author.

classes.name: Replies
classes.description: Contains reply nodes and total count for discussion replies.

classes.name: DiscussionsCommentsNode
classes.description: A discussion comment with potential replies.

classes.name: DiscussionsNode
classes.description: Represents a discussion thread with metadata and comments.

classes.name: DiscussionsEdge
classes.description: GraphQL edge containing a discussion node.

classes.name: DiscussionsResponseData
classes.description: Wrapper for discussions data in GraphQL response.

classes.name: DiscussionsResponse
classes.description: Full GraphQL response structure for discussions.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Configuration settings including GitHub token, repository, timeout, and speed multiplier.

classes.name: DiscussionExpertsResults
classes.description: Holds counters of commenters over various timeframes and author details.

methods.name: get_graphql_response
methods.description: Sends a GraphQL request to GitHub API and returns the parsed data.

methods.name: get_graphql_question_discussion_edges
methods.description: Retrieves discussion edges from GitHub GraphQL API, respecting rate limits.

methods.name: get_discussion_nodes
methods.description: Collects all discussion nodes by paginating through discussion edges.

methods.name: get_discussions_experts
methods.description: Analyzes discussion nodes to count commenters over different timeframes.

methods.name: get_top_users
methods.description: Returns a list of top commenters excluding specified users.

methods.name: get_users_to_write
methods.description: Prepares a list of users with counts for output, filtering by minimum count.

methods.name: update_content
methods.description: Updates a YAML file with new content if it has changed.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function that orchestrates data collection, analysis, file update, and PR creation.
